dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "This is the bulletin board for the Collective of Plenty. Tribal matters both great and small will be discussed here. Remember to check the board from time to time for the latest news."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you don't understand something written on the board, feel free to ask Chief Acatl directly. Don't be shy!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Children of Teteocan, hear my voice."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Do not be discouraged by setbacks, nor saddened by calamity."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The warm blood of youth shall flow for the people, and by their 'power' shall the young defend you."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The noblest of souls will be sown as seeds of flame, to lend strength to the heroes who will set Natlan free..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The new Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is about to begin! The shining star of the training ground — Uwe{RUBY#[D]Power}zo Iansan — will continue to lead the way!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "As is tradition, the right to take part can be earned through victory in the Grand Wrestling Grounds. Warriors of the Collective of Plenty, we look forward to your fervent participation!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Additionally, we will be organizing transport to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame for those who wish to spectate. We hope that every tribesperson can show their enthusiasm, and cheer on our champions live at the venue itself!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Warriors of the Collective of Plenty, thanks to your hard work, the Abyssal invasion has been defeated, and our losses have been kept to a minimum."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Special thanks must go to Varesa, whose prowess in combat was exemplary. Teteocan is proud to have a warrior such as you!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Even though the great enemy has been beaten back, this does not mean the threat is over. We cannot allow our diligent training to fade into lazy inactivity."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Warriors! For yourselves, for others, and — of course — for glory, we must continue to train hard, to turn our bodies into vessels of strength that will never crumble before any calamity!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "For our friends from afar, this round, empty space is known as the 'Grand Wrestling Grounds.' It is where wrestlers from the Collective of Plenty come to test their skills in competition."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "We welcome those with unshakeable belief in their strength and skill to climb atop the stage and put their wrestling prowess to the test — to engage in a bout that pits strength against strength."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "Friends! Let us vie for the title of 'The Collective of Plenty's Strongest Wrestler'! Come to the Grand Wrestling Grounds and fight to be the best!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, the highly anticipated showdown for the 'Grand Wrestling Extreme Championship' Belt is about to begin!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "For this competition, we will be welcoming a brand-new type of match — the '30-Man E-X-T-Reme Battle Royale'! 30 contestants will enter the ring one after the other, with their order being determined by their individual points rankings."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "The last contestant standing after all others have been eliminated will be crowned the Grand Wrestling Extreme Champion!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "As the saying goes, the wisest warrior is the one who shall laugh last. Then again, it's also said that the best-laid plans crumble in the face of absolute power!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "So, what kind of warrior will be the one left standing when the dust settles on the Grand Wrestling Grounds? Who will be the one who laughs last?"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "The strongest gladiator versus the strongest wrestler! Master and apprentice, who will win?"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "In one corner we have a legend of the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, with an unblemished record, the strongest warrior — U{RUBY#[D]Power}wezo Iansan!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "In the other corner, we have the undisputed 'Inferno Stomach Supremo,' protector of orchards, vanquisher of demons, and exemplar of wrestling strength — Varesa!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Wrestling Grounds Announcement
dialogues.text: "A warrior's muscles never betray their hard work! Wrestling will guide the way to Teteocan's glory! May the best warrior win! The match to decide the 'Grand Wrestling Ultimate Champion' is about to begin!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Be careful around the volcano! Watch out for falling rocks! Make sure to protect your heads!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Thanks to inspections from the Observation Crew and other volunteers, it has become clear that the Great Volcano of Tollan has been becoming more active recently. Some areas have even experienced extreme weather phenomena, including burning biological rain!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "In order to ensure everyone's safety, please stick to wide, open, and reliable roads when traveling."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "It is especially important that members of the tribe do not become complacent and think they are immune from danger simply because they've seen it all before! We all know the importance of discipline when lifting weights. The same level of attention and care should be applied to the volcano!"
